vectors.name: arithmetic-inconsistency-violations
vectors.note: Seeded internal inconsistencies. Hand-derived: USD closing stated 9 but roll-forward gives 5+1-2=4, violation COUNT-ROLLFORWARD at currencies[0].active_correspondents; USD corridor outbound count sums to 1000 against stated total 1500, violation CORRIDOR-SUM-COUNT at currencies[0].totals.outbound_count; USD single corridor gives outbound share 1.0 so both concentration flags fire on it (top share over 0.8, HHI 1 over 0.5); EUR block is internally consistent (roll-forward 2+0-0=2, sums 360/220 and 1.6M/1.3M, HHI 0.3828 under threshold) so contributes nothing. Violations sorted by path: active_correspondents before totals.outbound_count.

independent_oracle.source: CPMI correspondent banking chartpack (SWIFT BI Watch), pinned 2026-10-29 (research/clause-snapshots/cbr-data-return/cpmi-chartpack.txt)
independent_oracle.derivation: Internal-consistency identities applied by hand: closing correspondent count must equal opening plus opened minus terminated (4, not the stated 9); stated currency totals must equal the exact sum of corridor components (1000, not the stated 1500).
